title: Race Result Finish Time Monthly Rollup
dataSources: Race results (`raceresult:event`), TrainingPeaks workouts (`trainingpeaks:workout`), marathon splits (`race:split`), bib pickup and race logistics (`race:bib`).
app: Race result APIs, TrainingPeaks workouts and TSS, marathon split exports, and bib-collection checklists streamed to Splunk HEC via scripted REST inputs, CSV imports, and mobile forms.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=raceresult:event
| bin _time span=1mon
| stats sum(finish_time_min) as total_value avg(distance_km) as avg_duration count as sessions by _time
| sort - _time
description: Summarizes race result finish time by month so you can review season-to-date volume without digging through individual sessions.
value: A monthly rollup is useful for spotting big directional changes and for keeping a simple log of a long season.
implementation: Retain at least a season of history so month-over-month comparisons stay meaningful.
visualization: Column chart of monthly totals with average session duration overlaid.
grandmaExplanation: It maps the bigger month-by-month picture for race result finish time instead of one session at a time.
